_doc: Audio gaps for the Evidence-Gap Register (Law clauses 3 and 7). The register files in GOVERNANCE/register are regenerated by tools/bt/seed_register.py (which deletes and rewrites them), so these entries are kept here in the register's field layout; whoever owns the register adds them. Written 2026-10-31 by the AUDIO agent.

entries.description: No licensed recording of any specific 1863 weapon (Springfield, Enfield, Lorenz, Sharps, Spencer, Henry, cap-and-ball revolver, Napoleon, 3-inch rifle, Parrott, howitzer).
entries.evidence_searched: audio/PLAN.md 2.2 (Freesound, Commons, Internet Archive, LoC, NPS, academic sets); round 2 on 2026-10-31 (Commons US Army Bands calls and one USMA cannon item, Internet Archive advanced search): nothing new for weapons.
entries.substitute_applied: Real generic black-powder musket and one reenactment cannon recording as stand-ins where loaded; otherwise synthesis shaped by weapon class and checked against the real recordings' spectra.
entries.product_marking: Panel row 'small_arms' / 'artillery_report'; on-sound tag per DEC-001 flag.
entries.owner_decision: DEC-001 (labeling) for AUD-G01..G04; none requested for the others

entries.description: Bugle call and drum beat NOTATION of the 1862 manuals (Casey vol. 1 pp. 227-231; Hardee 1861 pp. 217-219) is not transcribed: only names and order are read (drill/DRILL-HARDEE-NOTES.md).
entries.evidence_searched: OCR text (no notation); archive.org page images fetched for Casey vol. 1: text pages are at leaf = printed page + 59 up to the plates (n250 = p. 191) but 32 plates are interleaved so the call pages are further on (n288 is a blank leaf, n289 is Plate 32); the leaf was not located within the bounded attempt.
entries.substitute_applied: Modern public-domain Army/Marine recordings of the call of the same name as stand-ins (never claimed as the 1863 notes); the procedural bugle plays nothing until a notation is transcribed; no call is invented.
entries.owner_decision: DEC-001 (labeling) for AUD-G01..G04; none requested for the others

entries.description: The Union cheer has no documented description; the rebel yell is described only in prose (and by lead sources); no recording of either as heard in 1863.
entries.evidence_searched: audio/PLAN.md 3.3; 1938 newsreel recordings of veterans: lead only, rights unchecked; Internet Archive search: nothing usable.
entries.substitute_applied: Layered formant-voice stylization (rebel yell high, rising and broken; cheer two-syllable and falling), marked.
entries.owner_decision: DEC-001 (labeling) for AUD-G01..G04; none requested for the others

entries.description: No recording of a shell in flight, a shell burst, canister, a caisson explosion, or impacts on ground, wood, stone, men and horses; no recording of drill handling (cartridge tear, rammer ring, ramming, cap).
entries.substitute_applied: Procedural models (resonant modes, noise bursts); shell flight is a moving source with Doppler along the animation's trajectory.
entries.owner_decision: DEC-001 (labeling) for AUD-G01..G04; none requested for the others

entries.description: Source levels (dB at 1 m), muzzle directivity, octave-band spectra, head-shadow and ground porosity are ASSUMED values, not measurements of black-powder weapons.
entries.evidence_searched: audio/PLAN.md 4.6; no black-powder acoustics source found; only one modern-rifle figure seen as a search snippet.
entries.substitute_applied: Order-of-magnitude values from physics.mjs; tests bound them against the spectra of the real recordings; every use is flagged ASSUMED.
entries.owner_decision: DEC-001 (labeling) for AUD-G01..G04; none requested for the others

entries.description: Whether the .58 rifle-musket bullet cracked (muzzle velocity 950 to 1,400 ft/s against Mach 1 about 1,125 ft/s) is unresolved; the engine plays no supersonic bullet crack or bullet flyby.
entries.substitute_applied: Muzzle report only; the shot-versus-report crossing is modelled for shells (far.mjs).
entries.owner_decision: DEC-001 (labeling) for AUD-G01..G04; none requested for the others

entries.description: The 1863 atmosphere (humidity, pressure, vertical profiles of wind and temperature) is unknown; the engine uses a uniform atmosphere: temperature documented at the Jacobs readings, humidity inferred, wind bearing inferred within S to SSW, speed a scenario choice (CF-WIND-SPEED).
entries.substitute_applied: Homogeneous model plus two explicit scenarios (shadow_zone, downwind_duct) that are never defaults; the model over-predicts range (no turbulence, no ground excess) and does not reproduce the documented non-hearing by Ewell's party.
entries.product_marking: documented-reports.json records the mismatch; far.mjs SCENARIOS.
entries.owner_decision: DEC-001 (labeling) for AUD-G01..G04; none requested for the others

entries.description: Echoes at Gettysburg: only qualitative accounts (hills rolling the cannonade, woods echoing musketry at Culp's Hill); no delays or distances; the DEM is modern bare earth (no 1863 trees); no woods mask exists, so the documented woods reverb boost is a hook only.
entries.evidence_searched: BL-3, MI-GB-1889, NY-GB-1900 passages in documented-reports.json.
entries.substitute_applied: Ridge echo taps from the DEM (specular and diffuse), a shared reverb that grows with distance; woods boost not applied by default.
entries.owner_decision: DEC-001 (labeling) for AUD-G01..G04; none requested for the others

entries.description: Nobody has listened: loudness (trim +22 dB, limiter), reverb, balance, the formant voices and the whole mix are unjudged; the Web Audio graph is tested only against a mock context.
entries.evidence_searched: This session cannot audition audio and runs no browser.
entries.substitute_applied: Objective measurements stand in (measurements.json); BROWSER-VERIFICATION-LIST-AUDIO.md lists the listening checks for the owner.
entries.owner_decision: DEC-001 (labeling) for AUD-G01..G04; none requested for the others

entries.description: Recordings are not packaged into the app build: the default build loads none and plays synthesis only; shipping them needs a packaging decision (the owner publishes drag-and-drop zips) and the attribution lines for CC BY items (FS-162628, FS-18229).
entries.substitute_applied: loader.mjs loads shippable ledger entries on request; the panel lists exactly what is loaded.
entries.owner_decision: DEC-001 (labeling) for AUD-G01..G04; none requested for the others

entries.description: Eight Commons Army Bands calls (Fatigue, Church, Drill, School, Double Time, To Arms, Fire Call, First Call) were not fetched: Wikimedia answered HTTP 429 and the pass was stopped to respect the access policy.
entries.substitute_applied: Retry with 60 s spacing in a later session.
entries.owner_decision: DEC-001 (labeling) for AUD-G01..G04; none requested for the others

entries.description: The rate and occurrence of misfires, the officers' actual commands at a real minute, and the sounds of men falling and crying are not documented.
entries.substitute_applied: No misfire sounds by default; only manual command words are voiced; a fall is an impact sound only (no cry).
entries.owner_decision: DEC-001 (labeling) for AUD-G01..G04; none requested for the others

entries.description: Voice budget defaults (160 individually sounded voices, 40 HRTF) and the planner's CPU cost on phones are not measured.
entries.evidence_searched: audio/PLAN.md 6.2 measured an AudioWorklet mixer (1,700 voices) in Chrome 155; the Web Audio graph here is unmeasured; planner cost measured in node only.
entries.substitute_applied: Budget and fold-to-bed policy with an honest indicator; browser measurement listed.
entries.owner_decision: DEC-001 (labeling) for AUD-G01..G04; none requested for the others
